text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Full bar = every AI bill NCSL tracked in that session year; dark segment = bills enacted into law.

g.text: A bill can carry several topics. Labels: enacted / introduced.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: NCSL annual AI legislation pages (2019–2024) and NCSL Artificial Intelligence Legislation Database, powered by LexisNexis State Net (2025–2026); downloaded Oct 14, 2026.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: Covers the 50 states, DC and U.S. territories. *2026 as of NCSL's latest monthly update; some bills are still pending. Adopted resolutions count as introduced, not enacted.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: The two sides of the line in (a) come from different NCSL products, so the 2024→2025 change mixes growth with broader tracking (the Deepfake topic first appears in 2025). (b) omits 66 2026 bills with no topic yet.
